sample_review.rationale: Round-two Luna repair narrows both failed sections to one spoken job while preserving only the accepted evidence needed for the Good's explanatory image and tyranny's enslavement reversal.

revisions.title: The longer route to the greatest study
revisions.body: The longer route is required because the inquiry has reached its greatest study: the Idea of the Good. The Good is what makes the just and other things useful. The sun image gives that role a clear shape: as the sun makes sight possible, the Good gives truth to what is known and power to the knower. The route lengthens toward this source.

revisions.title: Tyranny as enslavement
revisions.body: Here the city and the tyrannical soul reverse the appearance of command. The ruler seems to possess others, yet both city and soul are poor and insatiable, and fear and pain make that power inwardly needy. The prison image completes the reversal: the tyrant is bound by fears and desires, confined and unable to live as free men do. What looks like mastery is enslavement.

The “longer route” is therefore a demand for completion, not a decorative detour."
